tabs.html:
D CORE MPO 12C OM3 LSZH 5 Meter Multi-Mode 40G/100G Fiber Patch Cord – High-Speed Data Transmission

Upgrade your data center or network setup with the D CORE MPO 12C OM3 LSZH 5M Fiber Patch Cord, designed for 40G and 100G high-speed applications. This multi-mode patch cord ensures low insertion loss, excellent signal integrity, and reliable performance in demanding networking environments. Built with LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen) jacket, it provides enhanced safety and is ideal for indoor use in offices, server rooms, and data centers across Bangladesh.

Key Specifications:

  • Brand: D CORE
  • Type: MPO 12C Multi-Mode Fiber Patch Cord
  • Fiber Type: OM3 (Multi-Mode)
  • Length: 5 Meters
  • Speed Support: 40G / 100G Ethernet
  • Jacket: LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen)
  • Connector: MPO (12 Core)
  • Application: Data centers, server rooms, high-speed network links
  • Durability: High-quality fiber construction for minimal signal loss


This D CORE MPO 12C OM3 Fiber Patch Cord is perfect for Bangladesh IT professionals and network engineers who require fast, secure, and reliable connections for modern high-speed networks.
